21312-glyn-severn-s-schooldays.creator: Unknown
21312-glyn-severn-s-schooldays.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Hear, hear!" said Mr Rampson, the heavy, solid-looking classical master, impressed by the Principal's allusion to the Roman sports; and he grumbled out something in a subdued voice, with his eyes shut. What it was the boys did not hear, but it was evidently a Latin quotation, and ended in _ibus_.

arxiv-2204-05108.title: Improved Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Model Ensembles
arxiv-2204-05108.creator: Katsiaryna Haitsiukevich & Alexander Ilin
arxiv-2204-05108.description: Abstract Learning the solution of partial differential equations (PDEs) with a neural network is an attractive alternative to traditional solvers due to its elegance, greater flexibility and the ease of incorporating observed data. However, training such physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) is notoriously difficult in practice since PINNs often converge to wrong solutions.

arxiv-2206-04093.creator: R.J. Assef, F.E. Bauer, A.W. Blain, M. Brightman, T. Díaz-Santos, P.R.M. Eisenhardt, H.D. Jun, D. Stern, C.-W. Tsai, D.J. Walton, J.W. Wu

arxiv-2310-06738.title: Polarization Study of Single Color Centers in Aluminum Nitride
arxiv-2310-06738.creator: J.K. Cannon, S.G. Bishop, J.P. Hadden, H.B. Yağcı, A.J. Bennett
arxiv-2310-06738.description: Abstract Color centers in wide-bandgap semiconductors are a promising class of solid state quantum light source, many of which operate at room temperature. We examine a family of color centers in aluminum nitride which emit close to 620 nm 620\text{\,}\mathrm{nm} .

arxiv-2310-17857.title: From Values to Opinions: Predicting Human Behaviors and Stances Using Value-Injected Large Language Models
arxiv-2310-17857.creator: Dongjun Kang Joonsuk Park Yohan Jo JinYeong Bak
arxiv-2310-17857.description: Abstract Being able to predict people’s opinions on issues and behaviors in realistic scenarios can be helpful in various domains, such as politics and marketing. However, conducting large-scale surveys like the European Social Survey to solicit people’s opinions on individual issues can incur prohibitive costs.

arxiv-2404-05832.title: Human-Machine Interaction in Automated Vehicles: Reducing Voluntary Driver Intervention
arxiv-2404-05832.creator: Xinzhi Zhong, Yang Zhou, Varshini Kamaraj, Zhenhao Zhou, Wissam Kontar, Dan Negrut, John D. Lee, Soyoung Ahn
arxiv-2404-05832.description: Abstract This paper develops a novel car-following control method to reduce voluntary driver interventions and improve traffic stability in Automated Vehicles (AVs). Through a combination of experimental and empirical analysis, we show how voluntary driver interventions can instigate substantial traffic disturbances that are amplified along the traffic upstream.

arxiv-2409-02568.title: Fully polarized Fermi systems at finite temperature
arxiv-2409-02568.creator: Krzysztof Myśliwy and Marek Napiórkowski Institute of Theoretical Physics, Faculty of Physics, University of Warsaw Pasteura 5, 02-093 Warsaw, Poland
arxiv-2409-02568.description: Abstract We propose a simple model of an interacting, fully spin–polarized Fermi gas in dimensions d = 2 d=2 and d = 3 d=3 , and derive the approximate expression for the energy spectrum and the corresponding formula for the Helmholtz free energy.

arxiv-2411-00961.title: A rigidity theorem for Kolmogorov-type operators
arxiv-2411-00961.creator: Alessia E. Kogoj, Ermanno Lanconelli
arxiv-2411-00961.description: Abstract . Let D ⊆ R n D\subseteq{\mathbb{R}^{n}} , n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 , be a bounded open set and let x 0 ∈ D x_{0}\in D . Assume that the Newtonian potential of D D is proportional outside D D to the Newtonian potential of a mass concentrated at { x 0 } . \{x_{0}\}.

arxiv-2509-01340.title: Chaos on Peano continua
arxiv-2509-01340.creator: Klára Karasová, Benjamin Vejnar
arxiv-2509-01340.description: Abstract Generalizing the result of Agronsky and Ceder (1991), we prove that every Peano continuum admits a continuous transformation that is exact Devaney chaotic; that is, it has a dense set of periodic points, and every nonempty open set covers the entire space in finitely many iterations.

arxiv-2510-01737.title: Entropy for a class of micro-economic models
arxiv-2510-01737.creator: R.S.MacKay
arxiv-2510-01737.description: Abstract . Chater and MacKay [ CM ] derived an entropy function of state for exchange economies satisfying a list of axioms, and showed that a change of state of a system of such economies is possible if and only if their total entropy does not decrease.

arxiv-2602-07140.title: Microscopic origin of Rashba coupling from first principles: Layer-resolved orbital asymmetry in transition metal dichalcogenides
arxiv-2602-07140.creator: Miguel Morales Cócera 1,2, Marta Prada 1, Franz Fischer 1,2, Gabriel Bester 1,3
arxiv-2602-07140.description: Abstract Spin-orbit coupling in two-dimensional materials gives rise to a Rashba spin splitting when inversion and mirror symmetries are broken, yet its microscopic origin and quantitative characterization in transition metal dichalcogenides remains incomplete. Both symmetries are broken in certain bilayer structures, enabling Rashba splittings in the absence of external electric fields.

plos-pone-0004596.description: PLOS ONE research article. RT amplification reaction has revealed that various single viruses or viral co-infections caused acute bronchiolitis in infants, and RV appeared to have a growing involvement in early respiratory diseases. Because remaining controversial, the objective was to determine prospectiv

pmc-11331408.title: Structure and sequence at an RNA template 5′ end influence insertion of transgenes by an R2 retrotransposon protein
pmc-11331408.creator: Sarah M. Palm, Connor A. Horton, Xiaozhu Zhang, Kathleen Collins
pmc-11331408.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). R2 non-long terminal repeat retrotransposons insert site-specifically into ribosomal RNA genes (rDNA) in a broad range of multicellular eukaryotes. R2-encoded proteins can be leveraged to mediate transgene insertion at 28S rDNA loci in cultured human cells. This strategy, precise RNA-mediated insertion of transgenes (PRINT), relies on the codelivery of an mRNA encoding R2 protein and an RNA template encoding a transgene cassette of choice.

pmc-11527830.title: Targeting PI3K/AKT and MEK/ERK pathways for synergic effects on improving features of peripheral diabetic neuropathy
pmc-11527830.creator: Vuong M Pham
pmc-11527830.description: Diabetic neuropathy is one of the most serious and common complications of diabetes with a wide spectrum, affecting 30–50% of diabetic patients. However, the current treatments of this disorder, mainly based on controlling blood glucose level, show an inadequate clinical outcome. Better approaches are needed.

pmc-11641462.title: Covalent Adaptable Networks from Polyacrylates Based on Oxime–Urethane Bond Exchange Reaction
pmc-11641462.creator: Yu Sotoyama, Naoto Iwata, Seiichi Furumi
pmc-11641462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Covalent adaptable networks (CANs) are polymer networks cross-linked via dynamic covalent bonds that can proceed with bond exchange reactions upon applying external stimuli. In this report, a series of cross-linked polyacrylate films were fabricated by changing the combination of acrylate monomer and the amount of diacrylate cross-linker possessing oxime–urethane bonds as a kind of dynamic covalent bond to evaluate their rheological relaxation properties.

pmc-11691838.title: DEVELOPING THE NATIONAL STUDY OF CAREGIVING: CAREGIVING APPRAISAL MEASURE FOR CAREGIVERS OF PEOPLE WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-11691838.creator: Dingyue Wang, Susan Silva, Cristina Hendrix
pmc-11691838.description: This study aimed to develop and psychometrically validate the NSOC-Caregiving Appraisal (NSOC-CA) measure using data from the National Study of Caregiving (NSOC) IV Round 12. We also aimed to compare dementia and non-dementia caregiving experiences to determine whether this measure differentiates the caregiving experiences between the two groups.

pmc-12647647.title: Ophthalmology education and systemic disease integration in Syrian medical schools: a cross-sectional assessment of knowledge gaps
pmc-12647647.creator: Saja Karaja, Khayry Al-Shami, Ayham Qatza, Omran Faour
pmc-12647647.description: Ophthalmology plays a crucial role in medical practice by addressing vision impairment and detecting systemic diseases. However, ophthalmology education has declined globally despite the high prevalence of preventable blindness. A cross-sectional survey examined demographics, clinical experience, and training perspectives among Syrian fifth- and sixth-year medical students and ophthalmology residents in Syria.

pmc-12815909.title: A full-automated tumor budding annotation approach in hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole slide images of colorectal cancer
pmc-12815909.creator: Song Peng, Xiaona Chang, Yuehao Luo, He Tang, Ming Yang, Chunlin Zhong, Cong Deng, Shuang Hao, Yang Jin, Ming Li, Xiang Bai, Xiu Nie
pmc-12815909.description: Accurate and efficient grade assessment of tumor budding (TB) in hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole slide images (H&E-stained WSIs) of colorectal cancer (CRC) remains challenging. This study proposes a full-automated TB annotation approach to assist in manual grade assessment by extracting tumor invasive front boundaries, annotating TBs in tumor invasive front patches, and transferring annotations to WSIs.

pmc-13105924.title: Anthropometric predictors of hypertension among Moroccan adults: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13105924.creator: Chourite Chaimaa, Khossossi Hanae, Eljakani Elhoucine, Fedouache Mohammed, Challal Ismail, Zaguiri Mohammed, Mouilly Mustapha
pmc-13105924.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHypertension remains a major public health challenge worldwide, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. Obesity-related anthropometric indicators are widely used to assess cardiovascular risk; however, evidence regarding the most reliable predictors of hypertension remains inconsistent across populations.

pmc-13147113.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2499 STROKE IN YOUNG ADULTS: PREVALENCE, RISK FACTORS AND RECURRENCE IN A TERTIARY CENTER COHORT
pmc-13147113.creator: Maria Jose Hernandez Garcia, David Alejandro Padilla Leon, Carolina Hernández Javier, Gabriel Ricardo González Toledo, Marta Crespo Rodriguez, Marcial Lobato, Alba Elisa Bartolome Yumar, Jose Antonio Rojo Aladro
pmc-13147113.description: Background and aimsPrevalence of stroke in young adults has increased in recent years; however, data from our population is limited. We seek to analyze prevalence of stroke in patients younger than 55 years and to describe their clinical and etiological characteristics, major vascular risk factors (MVRF) , functional outcome and recurrence rates.

pmc-13220977.title: Acceptability of Technologies to Support Early Dementia Detection: Qualitative Study With the Boston University Alzheimer’s Disease Center Cohort
pmc-13220977.creator: Sarah Wilson, Emily Beswick, Zachary Popp, Salman Rahman, Sharandeep Bhogal, Tim Whitfield, Spencer Low, Raiyan Khan, Clare Tolley, Zuzana Walker, Rhoda Au, Sarah P Slight
pmc-13220977.description: BackgroundDementia is on the rise globally due to increasing life expectancies and population growth. Digital technologies may help detect early signs, enabling timely interventions to slow or reverse cognitive decline. However, to support the successful implementation of these digital technologies into health care settings, they must be acceptable to target users.

pmc-13267785.title: Access to public healthcare services for transgender people: experiences in Brazil’s capital*
pmc-13267785.creator: Ester Mascarenhas Oliveira, Carle Porcino, Cleuma Sueli Santos Suto, Hellen Torres Coelho, Paula Bastos Antunes, Dejeane de Oliveira Silva, Paulo Alberto Moura Marques, Luciana Neves da Silva Bampi, Ester Mascarenhas Oliveira, Carle Porcino, Cleuma Sueli Santos Suto, Hellen Torres Coelho, Paula Bast
pmc-13267785.description: Objective:To analyze transgender people’s experiences in accessing public healthcare services in Brazil’s capital.Method:This qualitative study involved 19 transgender individuals linked to three healthcare services in Brasília. The data, collected through in-depth interviews, were lexically analyzed using descending hierarchical classification with the aid of the software Interface de R pour les Analyses Multidimensionnelles de Textes et Questionnaires.

pmc-13363180.title: Vaccine nation: How immunisation shaped India, Macmillan (Pan Macmillan India Pvt. Ltd, New Delhi) 2025. 487 pages. Price: Not mentioned
pmc-13363180.creator: Sanjay Verma
pmc-13363180.description: offers a calm, evidence-based, and historically grounded narrative that is both timely and deeply relevant. The preface itself sets the tone, elegantly traversing the long arc of India’s immunisation story- from early experiments and colonial public health challenges to post-independence institution building and India’s emergence as a global vaccine leader.

pmc-13437759.title: Reassessing the adverse event profiles of levetiracetam and brivaracetam: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13437759.creator: Emma Fröling, Mariel Morales Sahm, Marcel Schmude, Charlotte P. Assies, Michael Wittenberg, Felix Rosenow, Felix Bermpohl, Thomas G. Riemer
pmc-13437759.description: ObjectiveTo synthesize adverse event (AE) data from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of levetiracetam (LEV) and brivaracetam (BRV), compare their safety profiles, and identify moderators of AE risk.MethodsWe conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs of LEV or BRV, searching PubMed, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov to August 2025.

pmc-13494554.creator: Erika C Pinheiro de Castro, Francesco Cicconardi, Ian A Warren, Nicol Rueda-M, Camilo Salazar, Søren Bak, Stephen H Montgomery, Chris D Jiggins

pmc-13554621.title: Investigation of the probability of losses in the external insulation layer of residential engineering projects using the weather test
pmc-13554621.creator: Zeyu Chen, Dongyang Geng, Yanwei Zhou, Baolin Li, Zhihan Su
pmc-13554621.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Increasing attention has been drawn to the delamination of the external thermal insulation layer, which severely impacts the residents’ living quality and insurers’ claim risks. Therefore, the probability distribution of losses caused by external insulation layer delamination is investigated in this study through weather tests, considering that such delamination occurs due to a bond strength of zero, in order to provide scientific support for the inherent defect insurance (IDI).

pmc-13560118.title: Breaking down breakfast: the relationship between morning meals and learning difficulties in adolescents
pmc-13560118.creator: Reza Rahmanian, Ali Razeghi Pirbasti, Mohsen Shaygantabar, Fatemeh Javaheri-Tafti, Leyli Zahra Bahreini-Boroujeni, Alireza Hatami, Andisheh Khoshrang, Leila Sajedi, Marjan Ajami, Mina Esmaili, Anahita Houshiarrad, Saeid Doaei
pmc-13560118.description: BackgroundLearning difficulties (LDs) impair academic performance and cognitive function. Dietary factors, particularly the composition of breakfast, may influence LDs.ObjectiveTo examine the association between breakfast composition and LDs in adolescents.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among 501 adolescents aged 10–19 from four schools in Jahrom, Iran.

pmc-13609543.title: Evaluation of the Biochemical, Colorimetric, and Microbiological Stability of Red Cabbage Anthocyanin Extracts for Application as Natural Indicators
pmc-13609543.creator: Loredana-Mariana Huțuțui, Sonia Amariei, Anca-Mihaela Gâtlan
pmc-13609543.description: Food spoilage is accompanied by changes in pH, which allows freshness to be monitored using colorimetric indicators. Due to their color response, the anthocyanins in red cabbage are of interest for smart packaging. However, their applicability depends on their stability during storage.
